new_value: Landed in 51b45d3d71 as a server-side lookup rather than a new store API (design refinement noted in bead comment): sos_post's pinned_key_for_addr enumerates lichen_key_store_list() and matches per-entry AddrForKey(pubkey) == parsed origin address, using the 12/12-vector-verified lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519. Store untouched (keeps coap_keys_lifecycle host test's standalone link valid). kimi-k3 security pass confirmed the AddrForKey==claimed binding is sufficient and stronger than IID matching (store enforces iid==pubkey-derived at pin time). SOS_PIN_SCAN_MAX=16 pinned to the store Kconfig range cap with BUILD_ASSERT backing.
